Location: Darwin / Batchelor, NT

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. They are seeking a Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper to join their growing team, offering stable employment, varied worksites, and a supportive work environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Clean and service guest rooms and common areas to schedule and site standards (sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, dusting, spot-cleaning).
- Make beds; change linen; restock towels and amenities (where applicable to site).
- Clean and sanitise bathrooms, kitchens and high-touch surfaces; replenish consumables.
- Empty and segregate waste; restock housekeeping trolleys and storerooms and handling lost property per policy.
- Manage basic stock levels and coordinate safe handling of cleaning chemicals; keep SDS current and accessible.
- Liaise with site contacts on service requirements and report maintenance or WHS hazards promptly.
- Operate equipment safely (e.g., commercial vacuums, microfibre/steam cleaners, pressure/steam equipment where trained).
- Adhering to cleaning schedules, room checklists and brand standards; using chemicals and equipment safely.

Selection Criteria:
1. Housekeeping proficiency: recent experience across hotel rooms and/or other commercial premises; strong eye for detail and presentation.
2. WHS & chemical safety: knowledge of safe work practices and SDS-guided chemical use.
3. Time management: ability to meet room/area turnaround targets and follow run sheets/checklists.
4. Communication: clear, courteous communication with clients, guests and team members; accurate incident/maintenance reporting.
5. Equipment skills: competent with standard housekeeping tools and commercial machines (training provided where required).
6. Quality standards: consistent delivery to brand/site standards; effective self-checks and sign-offs.
7. Flexibility: capacity to work shifts, some weekends/public holidays, and rotate across multiple Darwin sites.

Required Experience and Qualifications:
- 1 to 2+ years relevant commercial housekeeping/cleaning experience (multi-site preferred).
- Understanding of Commercial Cleaner task scope; safe chemical handling and WHS awareness.
- Full working rights in Australia
- Formal qualifications are not mandatory; on-the-job training evidence is valued.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and safety-minded Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper to join us and help deliver high-standard cleaning and housekeeping services.

To apply, please submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the Cleaner / Commercial Housekeeper role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 Aug 2026

Operations Manager – Commercial Cleaning Services

Centralian Cleaning Services
Alice Springs, NT
Full-time, permanent
Salary: $100,000–$120,000 per year plus superannuation, commensurate with experience

About us

Centralian Cleaning Services is an established and growing Alice Springs business delivering commercial cleaning services across a diverse portfolio of workplaces, schools, government facilities, accommodation, retail sites and community organisations.

We employ a multicultural team of approximately 20 staff and have built a strong reputation for reliable service, responsive client support and practical local knowledge.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to take responsibility for the day-to-day delivery of our commercial cleaning services across multiple client sites.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, this is a senior, hands-on management position responsible for workforce coordination, client service, quality assurance, workplace health and safety, operational systems and contract performance.

The Operations Manager will lead our operational team and ensure that services are delivered safely, efficiently, consistently and in accordance with client requirements.

Key responsibilities

• Plan, manage and coordinate daily cleaning operations across multiple commercial sites.

• Lead supervisors and cleaning staff, including workforce planning, staff allocation, rostering and operational support.

• Monitor staffing levels and coordinate recruitment, onboarding, training and performance management.

• Conduct site inspections and implement quality-control processes to maintain required cleaning standards.

• Establish and maintain cleaning procedures, site instructions, schedules and service-delivery systems.

• Manage new-site mobilisations and ensure client specifications are translated into practical operating plans.

• Develop positive working relationships with clients and respond promptly to service requests, concerns and changing operational requirements.

• Monitor contract performance, labour utilisation, productivity and operational costs.

• Oversee the appropriate use, maintenance and availability of cleaning equipment, vehicles, chemicals, consumables and other resources.

• Implement and monitor workplace health and safety requirements across client sites and the company’s operational base.

• Investigate incidents, service failures and complaints, identify underlying causes and implement corrective action.

• Support supervisors and employees working across different locations, schedules and levels of experience.

• Provide regular operational reporting and recommendations to the Managing Director.

About you

To be successful in this position, you will have:

• substantial experience managing service-based operations, preferably within commercial cleaning, facilities services, property services or another multi-site workforce environment;

• demonstrated experience leading operational employees and supervisors;

• strong workforce-planning, scheduling and resource-allocation capabilities;

• experience managing client relationships, service standards and contract performance;

• sound knowledge of workplace health and safety, incident management and operational risk;

• the ability to analyse operational problems and implement practical, sustainable solutions;

• strong organisational, communication and people-management skills;

• confidence working with employees from diverse cultural and language backgrounds;

• a relevant Diploma-level or higher qualification, or substantial relevant management experience demonstrating an equivalent level of skill;

• strong computer skills and experience using rostering, workforce-management and business systems;

• a current driver licence and the ability to travel between client sites in Alice Springs; and

• the flexibility to respond to operational requirements outside standard office hours when reasonably required.

Experience within the commercial cleaning industry will be highly regarded but is not essential where the applicant can demonstrate strong transferable experience managing a multi-site service workforce.

What we offer

• A permanent senior management position with an established local business.

• A competitive salary of $100,000–$120,000 plus superannuation, depending on the successful applicant’s qualifications and experience.

• The opportunity to take genuine ownership of day-to-day operations.

• Direct involvement in improving systems, developing employees and supporting continued business growth.

• A varied role combining team leadership, client management, quality assurance and operational improvement.

How to apply

Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining:

• your relevant operational management experience;

• the size and type of workforce or operations you have managed;

• your experience managing services across multiple sites or clients; and

• why you are interested in relocating to or continuing to work in Alice Springs.

Applicants requiring employer sponsorship may be considered where they meet the skills, experience and visa eligibility requirements for the position.
